title: Essential Monitoring
summary: A low-clutter workspace for peak level, loudness, stereo image, and core readouts.
descriptionMarkdown: Keep the monitoring essentials visible without the full analysis workspace. A full-height Peak Level Meter with TP Max sits beside a 60-second Loudness history, while Polar Level Stereo Image and a six-metric Monitoring Summary provide compact spatial and numeric context. The Preset keeps Loudness Profile and Dock off, so it remains a source-neutral everyday workspace rather than a delivery target or alternate window mode.
